qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the plug in rear casing section on all transmission types?
What screw size and torque is required for the sealing caps on rear case section for 240/260/280 transmissions?
What is the torque specification for the reversing bolt to reversing lever on ZF S-5-16/5 S D 310 Z transmissions?
How much torque should be applied to clamping claws to rear case section?
qa_pairs.answer: 33 Nm for ZF S-5-16/5 S D 310 Z transmissions.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque value for screws on detent plate?
qa_pairs.answer: 9 Nm for ZF S-5-16/5 S D 310 Z transmissions.

qa_pairs.question: Which transmission types use M16 screws with 40 Nm torque for the plug in rear casing section?
What screw size is used for the plug in rear casing section on 260/280 transmissions?
What section of the manual does this torque specification table cover?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-5 Manual transmission, specifically 23 11 Case and Covers.

qa_pairs.question: Which components in this table have the same torque specification of 43 Nm and 33 Nm respectively?
qa_pairs.answer: The reversing bolt to reversing lever has 43 Nm, and the clamping claws to rear case section has 33 Nm, both for ZF S-5-16/5 S D 310 Z transmissions.

qa_pairs.question: What are the reference numbers for the sealing caps and reversing bolt components?
qa_pairs.answer: 12AZ for sealing caps on rear case section and 13AZ for reversing bolt to reversing lever.
